Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 118: January 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #118 shipped to subscribers in December 2010 (bearing the cover date of January 2011 for Issue 118). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #118 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Crysis 2 (first-person sci-fi shooter)
Fight Night Champion (sports boxing simulation)
Shift 2: Unleashed (racing simulation)
Beyond Good & Evil HD (Xbox Live Arcade remastered action-adventure)
Bejeweled 3 (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle)
Full Ninjas (Xbox Live Arcade action)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Battlefield 3, and Mass Effect 3, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
